instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: exaggerated. in the sentence.

atoms.b: Accounts of her exploits were greatly ((exaggerated)).
In particular, her telling of the race to Antarctica was ((exaggerated)), as they did not ride on the backs of polar bears.
((exaggerated))

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: advantage. in the sentence.

atoms.b: Wearing fins while racing in a pool would be too big of an ((advantage)), it would make it unfair.
Who do you think would have the ((advantage)) in a race: a dolphin or a squid?
((advantage))

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: admission. in the sentence.

atoms.b: I have an ((admission)) to make. I drank the rest of the juice.
It is too early to begin thinking about uni ((admission)).
((admission))

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: adventure. in the sentence.

atoms.b: You can have an ((adventure)) just by reading a book.
I went on the most marvellous ((adventure)) with my friend Harry.
((adventure))

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: approval. in the sentence.

atoms.b: I don’t want to ask for ((approval)) before going to the park, but I have to.
I also have to have parental ((approval)) to go on the school trip.
((approval))

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: persuade. in the sentence.

atoms.b: If I could just ((persuade)) my mum that she likes tacos, we could eat them for dinner more often.
My next task will be to ((persuade)) all my friends, then I could have tacos every day.
((persuade))

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: rumour. in the sentence.

atoms.b: Sometimes a ((rumour)) can be very hurtful. You should be careful before passing them on.
I heard a ((rumour)) that Jane would run for prefect again this year.
((rumour))

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: appear. in the sentence.

atoms.b: I am afraid that the wizard will ((appear)) in my dream again tonight.
The fireman will ((appear)) at our school tomorrow to talk about fire safety.
((appear))
